requirements.statement: Product is a universal personal research/intelligence bank around ChatGPT, not a vacancy/freelance-specific product.
User can save arbitrary useful material independently of an active research project.
Saved items can later act as search seeds, research inputs/results, evidence/reference, comparison items, collection members, or watch subjects.
Repeated research enriches one longitudinal bank/history rather than producing isolated reports only.
System supports scope/coverage-aware current state, changes, trends, lifecycle/history, and research health.
ChatGPT is the primary interactive reasoning/orchestration layer; the application owns durable state/history/UI/deterministic contracts.
Sources/tools/providers are reusable but replaceable; research semantics should depend on capabilities/contracts rather than vendor brands.
New domains should normally be added through Domain Packs rather than universal-core schema rewrites.
Preserve provenance, history, comparability, counterevidence and command/query boundaries.
Discovery is not measurement; search-result frequency is not demand/prevalence without valid method/sampling.
Raw evidence, canonical identity, annotation, derived representation, analytical projection and search ranking remain distinct epistemic layers.
“Complete/current state” is always relative to declared scope, method and coverage; never imply total-world exhaustiveness by default.
Persist Asset, Entity, Observation, Annotation and Collection with stable IDs and basic provenance.
Save supported file/URL/note/object without requiring research.
Browse item detail, collections, basic history and exact/full-text local-bank search.
Persist Source and SourcePolicy.
Persist ResearchLens with semantic intent/filters/seeds/time/ranking intent.
Compile immutable RunSpec before a tracked run; no silent last-value-wins config precedence.
Persist ResearchRun linked to RunSpec and provenance.
Persist ResultSet/ResultOccurrence so historical run membership/order/reasons can survive later model/index changes.
Expose stable application operations so ChatGPT can save/retrieve bank items and record/retrieve research state/results.
Use ChatGPT native web/Deep Research and optional ChatGPT-accessible connectors by default; direct provider APIs are not MVP assumptions.
Prove at least freelance longitudinal flow, game/mechanics-oriented object flow, and arbitrary image/file saving at design/implementation acceptance level.
Support typed Relation layer sufficient for graph/research/provenance use cases.
Support Event objects with domain-relevant time semantics.
Support MetricObservation with method/unit/scope/provenance.
Support versioned Representations such as embeddings, OCR, captions, perceptual hashes and domain feature vectors.
Support reusable SourceRoute history/configuration distinct from Source identity.
Support reusable ResearchRecipe owning methods/tools/steps but not semantic intent or cadence.
Support Watch over entity, collection, lens/query, similarity neighborhood, metric/relation or source health.
Support vendor-neutral Capability and CapabilityExecutor abstractions.
Support cross-run/cross-source entity resolution, confidence, merge/split/correction history and reprojection.
Support structured, full-text, semantic, example, multimodal, domain-structural, temporal, change, graph/evidence-lineage and hybrid search over time.
Support multiple explainable similarity profiles/dimensions rather than one opaque universal score.
Support first/last seen, reappearance/reopen, as-of history, comparable repeated runs and explicit coverage.
Retain/generalize CurrentStateSnapshot, ChangeSet, TrendSeries, InterpretationRecord and ResearchHealthSnapshot.
Support claim→evidence verification and important-claim statuses SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/CONTRADICTED/INSUFFICIENT/MISSCOPED/SOURCE_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT.
Support counter-search as a reusable serious-research stage; lack of found counterevidence is not proof.
Support separable independent verification context/role for high-value claims.
Distinguish evidence admissibility/dependency for raw source, user note, AI annotation, derived metric and summaries.
Support source genealogy/dependency relations where false triangulation matters.
Treat retrieval runs/providers as measurable process where practical; evaluate marginal evidence rather than assume independence.
Provide basic distributions/quantiles, novelty/change decomposition, velocity/persistence, lifecycle/cohort/source-divergence/coverage-aware analysis as data permits.
Personal fit/taste/skill relevance is a projection over bank observations/profile, not raw entity truth.
Provide persistent UI surfaces for Bank/Discover/Collections/Research/Current/Changes/Trends/Watch/Sources/History/Evidence/Health as product matures.
Stable UI selections/IDs can be passed into ChatGPT for compare/explain/find-similar/research/save/watch actions.
Domain Packs can declare domain types/properties/metrics/identity/extraction/source/similarity/analysis/UI hints/tests.
Add scheduler/background jobs/retries/idempotency/budget/alerts/automatable executors.

Support search with positive and negative examples, specifying which similarity dimensions to include or avoid; let the user choose a negative-example preference that lowers rank or a hard exclusion, and explain the applied match and exclusion reasons.
requirements.scope: Target product capability; explicitly outside MVP requirements.
requirements.rationale: User approved the target capability to express unwanted similarity through examples. Actual search quality gains must be evaluated rather than assumed.
acceptance_criteria: A supported query or similarity profile records positive and negative seed IDs and the dimensions to include or avoid.
The user can distinguish a negative-example preference that lowers rank from a hard exclusion; unsupported modes are disclosed rather than silently approximated.
Returned results explain the positive match and negative-example effects; rejected candidates have traceable exclusion reasons where available.
Quality is compared on relevant tasks with and without negative examples using human relevance judgments; the feature alone is not evidence of improved ranking.

change_history.reason: User approved promotion to TARGET_REQUIRED after discussing potential search-quality value, dimension-specific negative examples, soft preference vs hard exclusion, explanations and evaluation; MVP scope does not expand.

origin.context: Approval of the assistant proposal to promote OPP-017 to TARGET_REQUIRED outside MVP.

extension_axes.name: Domain breadth
extension_axes.expansion_direction: new domain packs and domain providers

current_strategy.interactive_research: ChatGPT-first using native web/Deep Research and optional ChatGPT-accessible external tools/connectors.
current_strategy.application_focus: Persistent Bank, history, research state, provenance, projections, UI, and later reliable automation.
current_strategy.direct_integrations: Deferred until a conditional trigger demonstrates need.
current_strategy.provider_evaluation: Measure marginal useful/independent evidence, overlap, primary-source discovery, counterevidence, cost and latency rather than assuming provider diversity.

reasoning_questions: Which requirement or user outcome does this proposal support?
What classification does it have now?
Which AX-V extension axes does it change?
Does it violate an invariant or anti-goal?
Does it activate a conditional trigger?
Can ChatGPT/existing tools satisfy it before custom infrastructure?
Is it domain-specific and better placed in a Domain Pack?
Is stored output canonical evidence, annotation, derived representation, projection, or result occurrence?
What concrete scenario and evidence justify promotion to a stronger requirement?
